title.heading: Halflight
title.subheading: A podcast and magazine website: episodes with chapters and audio, print issues with a contents page, a 24-hour shift clock drawn on the server, and a members-only back room.

end.heading: Built with Raytha
end.subheading: Open-source .NET CMS. Get the brief, screenshots and a one-command rebuild kit.

scenes.caption: The latest episode, and every guest's shift on a 24-hour clock with the current time, drawn on the server
An episode: audio, chapters, show notes, the shift, and letters about it
A print issue: the cover, the editor's letter and a contents page built from its stories
The hour index: pick 3 am and the server lists who is at work, and what was written then
Signed out, the back room shows titles only; the rest stays on the server
Signed in as a member: bonus episodes, the archive and the next issue early
